.setup:
  set_base_variables:
    # Set build variables.
    - export CHANNEL=$(echo $CI_COMMIT_TAG | cut -d '_' -f 2)
    - export FLAVOR=$(echo $CI_COMMIT_TAG | cut -d '_' -f 3)
    - if [[ "ni" != "$FLAVOR" ]]; then export APP_ID="${CHANNEL}.wemove.umweltnavi.${FLAVOR}"; else export APP_ID="${CHANNEL}"; fi
    # Set version code with default increment base 1000.
    - export VERSION_CODE=$((1000 + $CI_PIPELINE_IID))

build_android:
  variables:
    GIT_CLEAN_FLAGS: -x -f -e build/** -e android/**
  before_script:
    - !reference [.setup, set_base_variables]
    # Summarize build settings.
    - echo "Building android app for flavor [${FLAVOR}] with app_id [${APP_ID}] and version_code [${VERSION_CODE}]."
    - export AAB_PATH="build/app/outputs/bundle/${FLAVOR}Release/app-${FLAVOR}-release.aab"
    # Generate secret files.
    - mkdir -p assets/keys/ && echo $API_KEYS_JSON > assets/keys/api_keys.json
    - echo $ANDROID_KEYSTORE_HEX | xxd -r -p - > android/signing-keystore.jks
    - echo $ANDROID_KEY_PROPERTIES_HEX | xxd -r -p - > android/key.properties
    - echo $ANDROID_GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_JSON > android/google-services.json
  script:
    - docker run --rm -w /bipu -v $PWD:/bipu ghcr.io/cirruslabs/flutter:3.35.7 /bin/sh -c "flutter clean && flutter build appbundle --build-number $VERSION_CODE --flavor $FLAVOR --dart-define=PARTNER=$FLAVOR --dart-define=cronetHttpNoPlay=true"
    - docker run --rm --tty --workdir /bipu --volume $PWD:/bipu:rw,z -e APP_ID=$APP_ID -e AAB_PATH=$AAB_PATH theatlocon/gitlab-ci-android-fastlane /bin/bash -c "yes | sdkmanager --licenses && fastlane android upload"
  after_script:
    - rm -f assets/keys/api_keys.json
    - rm -f android/key.properties
    - rm -f android/signing-keystore.jks
    - rm -f android/google-services.json
  tags:
    - android
  rules:
    # The tag must in build_{CHANNEL}_{PARTNER} format to trigger build, e.g. build_dev_sh.
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^build_.*_[a-z]{2}$/

build_ios:
  variables:
    LC_ALL: "en_US.UTF-8"
    LANG: "en_US.UTF-8"
    GIT_STRATEGY: clone
  before_script:
    - !reference [.setup, set_base_variables]
    # Summarize build settings.
    - echo "Building ios app for flavor [${FLAVOR}] with app_id [${APP_ID}] and version_code [${VERSION_CODE}]."
    - export IPA_PATH="build/ios/ipa/output.ipa"
    # Generate secret files.
    - export CURL_SSL_BACKEND="secure-transport"
    - export FASTLANE_APPLE_APPLICATION_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD="$FASTLANE_APPLE_APPLICATION_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD"
    - mkdir -p assets/keys/ && echo $API_KEYS_JSON > assets/keys/api_keys.json
  script:
    - fvm use 3.35.7
    - fvm flutter clean
    - fvm flutter build ipa --build-number $VERSION_CODE --flavor $FLAVOR --dart-define=PARTNER=$FLAVOR
    # Generalize output name.
    - mv -n build/ios/ipa/*.ipa $IPA_PATH
    - fastlane ios upload
  after_script:
    - rm -f assets/keys/api_keys.json
  tags:
    - ios
  rules:
    # The tag must in build_{CHANNEL}_{PARTNER} format to trigger build, e.g. build_dev_sh.
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^build_.*_[a-z]{2}$/
=== fvm config ===
.gitignore:51:.fvm/

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat .gitlab-ci.yml | head -80; echo "=== fvm config ==="; ls -la .fvm 2>/dev/null; cat .fvmrc 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "fvm" .gitignore .metadata 2>/dev/null | head
